dedupe_keys.name: wrf simulation dataset for assessing the effects of urban building height changes in the yangtze river delta 7 12 july 2020

description: Jialing Xin and Yuanjie Zhang publish hourly WRF 4.6.0 simulation outputs for the Yangtze River Delta during 7–12 July 2020 UTC. The released inner domain has one-kilometre resolution and covers Nanjing, Shanghai, Suzhou and surrounding areas. Two ZIP downloads, BH2010 and BH2020, differ in prescribed building heights while retaining 2020 land use and matching meteorological forcing and physical settings. The model couples multilayer building effects with building energy calculations. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The paired experiments can support simulations of how urban form affects heat and airflow. Their short weather window and controlled assumptions limit generalisation; internal formats, output variables and observational error remain unknown from the summary. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these experiment outputs. The archives were not downloaded, and the causal interpretation is limited to the stated model experiment.
